What we automated there
One path · three steps

Onboarding. KYC. Invoice.

01
Onboarding
Talks to the client on the channel they already use — email, WhatsApp, whatever is convenient. Understands what they need, which entity, which work — then sends them into KYC.
02
KYC
Builds and parses the document list for the engagement. For accounting, that list depends on the company’s emirate. Collects the files, flags what is missing, and issues the engagement letter after human approval.
03
Invoice
Once the scope is clear, it prepares and raises the invoice. A person still confirms the number and the send.

The 80% is overall manual hours in that engagement — not a per-workflow result, and not a forecast for a team in Spain.

The human seat
The rule in every build

Agents prepare.
People decide.

Routine work follows your approved answers and rules. Legal advice, compliance decisions, and commitments stay with a named specialist. Software does not make a team compliant.

Stays with the specialist
Eligibility, legal advice, KYC/AML decisions where applicable, and binding offers or filings.
Moves to the agent
Answer approved routine questions, collect files, spot gaps, update status, and prepare the next step.
Always named
A process owner reviews exceptions. The system never silently passes a missing file.
